title: Issue 0006's sweep left a third hardcoded roster copy, in prez.bats
body:
## Tags

testing, latent, growth, roster

## Summary

Issue 0006 swept the framework for copies of "the current roster is the final roster" and fixed two. It left a third, in a file added the same day: `opt/prez/test/prez.bats` asserted `assert_output_contains "14 utilities"`.

Adding `stampz` as the fifteenth utility (ST0011) turned prez's suite red. The failure text names prez and the Emacs-adjacent doctor count, and the cause was a utility added in an unrelated thread -- exactly the diagnosis cost 0006 identified as the reason it mattered.

Two further copies were found in prose during the same sweep:

- `docs/index.md` read `All 12 shipped utilities have their own help files:` followed by twelve names, while the tree held fifteen. Stale by three.
- `README.md`'s directory tree carried `# (12 utilities total)`, also stale by three, and its `## Included Utilities` section was missing `prez`, `todo` and `stampz` entirely.

## Reproduction

Before the fix, with `stampz` present:

```
$ utilz test prez
not ok 19 utilz doctor counts prez and stays green
#   `assert_output_contains "14 utilities"' failed
```

`utilz doctor` reports `Found 15 utilities`, correctly.

## Root Cause

The same root cause 0006 recorded, one file over: **a count is the cheapest possible assertion and it is pinned to a moment rather than to a property.**

0006's own fix note says the sweep made `bridge.bats` derive its expected count "by walking the yaml corpus ... so the two agree by construction rather than by coincidence". That reasoning applies verbatim to `prez.bats:278`, which was written on 2026-08-29 -- the same day, in the same thread -- and was not covered because the sweep was scoped to the two checks whose failure text had been observed.

**A sweep bounded by the symptoms it saw is bounded by the wrong thing.** The property "no test hardcodes the size of the roster" is greppable and was never grepped.

## Impact

Medium, and identical in shape to 0006: it does not affect behaviour, it fires on normal growth, and the first symptom is an unrelated-looking test going red in a thread that never touched it. The prose copies are lower severity but worse in one respect -- nothing fails when documentation goes stale, so `docs/index.md` had been wrong for two utilities before this and no check reported it.

## Resolutions

Fixed 2026-09-03 in ST0011.

**(a) `opt/prez/test/prez.bats`** derives the count from the dispatcher listing, using the same `utilz list | awk '/^  [a-z]/'` idiom CI's macOS leg already uses to derive its test roster, so there is one convention for "what is the utility set" rather than two. The number was NOT bumped from 14 to 15: that fixes today and moves the same misattributed red onto the sixteenth utility.

A floor is asserted separately (`n > 0`), because a broken listing would make `0 utilities` compare equal to a doctor that also found none, and an empty measurement is not a passing one -- the same second assertion 0006's fix added for the same reason.

An explicit `assert_output_contains "prez"` on `utilz list` was added, because with the count derived, nothing in the test mentioned prez any more. The test is named "counts prez and stays green"; a derived count alone would have passed on a roster prez had dropped out of.

Verified: `utilz test prez` green across all three suites, acceptance 12 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped.

**(b) The prose copies** were removed rather than corrected. `docs/index.md` now says every shipped utility has a help file and points at `utilz list` as the roster; `README.md`'s tree comment says one symlink per utility. Both name the reason inline, so the next person to reach for a count reads why it is not there. `README.md` also gained the three missing `## Included Utilities` sections.

`docs/index.md` additionally restated the framework version as `2.2.0` while `VERSION` read `2.5.0` -- a third copy of the single source of truth, stale across three releases. Replaced with a pointer, matching the fix `help/utilz.md` already carries for the identical defect.

## Related

- 0006 -- the same root cause, swept two days earlier; this is the copy that sweep missed
- 0002 -- the other latent defect that only fires on a new utility (generator's `utilz_version` floor)
- ST0011 -- the thread that surfaced it, by adding the fifteenth utility
